title: Common definitions
description: Shared definitions for all universe-platform record contracts. Schema contracts are versioned; SCHEMA_VERSION is the current major.

schema_version.description: Contract schema major version. Bump with a migration script and ADR.

record_id.description: Opaque, stable, namespace-prefixed record ID, e.g. 'concept.fixture.example' or 'cosmology'. IDs are never reused after deprecation.

lifecycle_status.description: Publication lifecycle of the record itself. This is NOT evidence status and NOT proof of review: approval requires a maintainer-recorded review decision bound to the record hash.

evidence_status.description: Scientific evidential standing of a claim, kept separate from lifecycle.

date.description: Calendar date (ISO 8601, no time, no timezone).

url.description: HTTPS-only URL. http:// is rejected; there is no reason to fetch or link insecure origins.
